newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland plans to raise heating prices twice in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Poland plans to raise heating prices twice in 1997.

text.p: The Polish government's economic council (KERM) on Monday recomended to the full cabinet that household heating and hot water prices will increase twice in 1997, a finance ministry official said.
Stefan Lober from the ministry's national economy department said the KERM plan envisaged a 10 percent increase in heating prices in January and five percent in July 1997.
KERM's proposal now has to be passed by the full government to become law.
Poland last increased household heating and hot water prices by about five percent on October 1, 1996.
